title: The termwise cone of an additive natural transformation is exact on homotopy categories
statement: Let $A,B$ be preadditive categories with zero objects and binary biproducts [def-weil-preadditive-category], and suppose $B$ has countable coproducts. Let $F,G:A\to B$ be additive functors and $\tau:F\to G$ a natural transformation. Define a functor $C_\tau$ on integer cochain complexes by $C_\tau(P)=\operatorname{Cone}(\tau_P:F(P)\to G(P))$, with differential on $F(P)^{n+1}\oplus G(P)^n$ given by $(-d_Fx,\tau x+d_Gy)$ and maps induced diagonally by $F(f),G(f)$. There exist a functor $H:K(A)\to K(B)$, a natural isomorphism $\pi_A H\cong C_\tau\pi_B$, and a coherent integer shift comparison making $H$ triangulated [def-weil-triangulated-category]. Here $\pi$ denotes the quotient by chain homotopy. Neither boundedness, abelian structure, exactness of $F,G$, nor preservation of quasi-isomorphisms is assumed.

proof.text: The category of additive functors A to B is preadditive, with zero functor and pointwise binary biproducts. To verify closure under limits, compose a proposed additivity equation with each pointwise limit projection; naturality and additivity of every diagram functor prove it, and joint monicity gives the equation. Evaluation E:(A ⥤+ B) → (A ⥤ B) is additive in each variable.

In that additive-functor category form k=Cone(τ[0]:F[0]→G[0]). Countable coproducts in B supply all totalizations for E. Apply fixed-argument total-bifunctor exactness to obtain H=Tot_E(k,-) on homotopy categories with its coherent exact shift.

For each P, distributing totalization across the first-variable mapping cone gives Tot_E(k,P) ≅ Cone(Tot_E(τ[0],P)). The degree-zero single-complex comparisons identify its two endpoints with F(P),G(P), and their commuting-square equation identifies the cone map with τ_P. Apply the cone isomorphism of a commuting square. Naturality is checked on the two cone inclusions: the inverse comparison inserts the source in first degree -1 and the target in degree 0; the total-map formulas and evaluation naturality make both equations equal. Thus these comparisons form a natural isomorphism from totalization to C_τ.

Whisker that natural isomorphism with π_B and compose it with the homotopy-quotient comparison of the total bifunctor. Package this comparison with H and the shift and triangulatedness already supplied by fixed-argument exactness. This yields the asserted existential without choosing any data from an unproved theorem. Zero functors, τ=0, unbounded complexes and zero categories satisfy the same formulas.

lean.statement:
theorem termwiseCone_homotopy_exact [HasZeroObject A] [HasBinaryBiproducts A]
    [HasZeroObject B] [HasCountableCoproducts B] (F G : A ⥤ B) [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
    (τ : F ⟶ G) :
    ∃ (H : HomotopyCategory A (.up ℤ) ⥤ HomotopyCategory B (.up ℤ))
      (_ : HomotopyCategory.quotient A (.up ℤ) ⋙ H ≅
        termwiseCone F G τ ⋙ HomotopyCategory.quotient B (.up ℤ))
      (c : H.CommShift ℤ), letI := c; H.IsTriangulated
lean.note: The cone functor has concrete object and diagonal-map data. All helpers and the public exactness theorem are proved; no sorry is introduced.
